description: 22 Add-Car stress cases: realistic Chinese CA phrasing for ZIP variants, driver micro-phrases, and materials question vs already-sent (incl. prospective-send reply polish). Rule path; LLM off in runner.

scenarios.name: ZIP: 邮编95131（无空格）
scenarios.why_matters: Most common WeChat style; regex must not require word boundaries beside Chinese.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: zip in collected_fields; quote_ready when combined with year/model + delivery + driver in same merged text.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: zip missing from collected; asks for zip again.

turns.text: 想加一台2024本田思域，邮编95131，下周提车，我自己开

scenarios.name: ZIP: 邮编 95131（有空格）
scenarios.why_matters: Customers often type a space after 邮编.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: 95131 extracted; same as Z01.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: ZIP not detected.

scenarios.why_matters: Real phrasing may omit 开; tests substring markers.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: Ideally driver/spouse recognized; acceptable if broker still asked to confirm.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Treats as no driver and wrong handoff timing.

scenarios.failure_looks_like: No driver field.

scenarios.name: Materials: 要不要发你（应视为询问/新信息，非已发）
scenarios.why_matters: Regression guard for already_sent false positive.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: follow_up_type new_info; reply answers or asks cleanly, not “您说发过了”.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: already_sent + 核对发过的材料.

scenarios.why_matters: 要不要…发 中间插入宾语.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: Prospective-send guard; new_info.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Misclassified already_sent.

scenarios.why_matters: Completed send → warmer handoff / verify materials.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: follow_up_type already_sent; broker mentions verify WeChat; not demanding driver again inappropriately.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Ignores sent claim; cold repeat ask.

scenarios.why_matters: Quote-ready thread then materials-offer question.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: Turn 2: new_info / clarification, not false already_sent; stays add-car.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Broken tone or wrong follow-up classification.

scenarios.name: Materials: 要不我发你微信你看下行不行（征询发送渠道）
scenarios.why_matters: Office-style permission ask with 行不行; must not hit already_sent.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: follow_up_type new_info; reply leads with short 可以/微信 line, then normal handoff.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Generic handoff with no answer to the WeChat question.

turns.text: 加车 2024 Toyota Camry，92801，下周提车，我开，要不我发你微信你看下行不行

scenarios.name: Materials: 我先发给你看看行吗（信息未齐时）
scenarios.why_matters: Customer offers to send docs before slots complete; still collecting.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: Turn 2 new_info; brief send-ok line + next add-car ask (not echo-only).
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Ignores permission question or misclassifies already_sent.

scenarios.failure_looks_like: Cold repeat ask with no acknowledgment.
